1. FORMATION OF CONTRACTUAL AGREEMENT. These General Terms and Conditions (the "Terms") shall be, and hereby are, incorporated into that certain proposal (the "Proposal") prepared by Epang Engineering, Inc. (the "Engineer") and accepted by the client (the "Client") for services rendered pursuant to the Proposal; including any amendments or changes thereto (collectively, the "Services"). The Proposal and the Terms are at times referred to herein collectively as the "Agreement". The Engineer and the Client are at times referred to herein collectively as the "Parties" and individually as "Party". Engineer has agreed to perform the Services in reliance upon Client's acknowledgment that the Agreement is legally binding upon the Parties and that the Agreement shall inure to the benefit of, and be binding upon, each Parties' respective heirs, successors, assigns, directors, officers, members, employees, agents, subcontractors and/or representatives.
2. SCOPE OF SERVICES. The Engineer agrees to perform only the Services as described in the Agreement. If Client requests additional services that would require extra work or additional time to complete (the "Additional Services"), the Parties shall endeavor to execute an amendment or change order detailing the Additional Services. Should Engineer agree to perform the Additional Services prior to or absent a written agreement, the Terms shall remain in full force and effect with respect to the Additional Services. It is expressly agreed to by Client that Engineer's undertaking of the Additional Services is conditioned upon the Terms continuing to be in full force and effect. When necessary or deemed advisable by Engineer, portions or the Services or Additional Services may be subcontracted to one or more qualified firms or individuals with or without prior written notice to Client. If the Services or Additional Services are initiated by the Engineer prior to execution of the Proposal, written amendment or change order as an accommodation to Client, the Parties shall consider that commencement of Services or Additional Services constitutes formal acceptance of the Agreement, written amendment or change order and shall specifically include the Terms.
3. OWNERSHIP AND USE OF DOCUMENTS. Unless otherwise specified in the Agreement all documents produced by Engineer pursuant to the Agreement (including any Additional Services), including but not limited to CAD files, drawings, reports, sketches, recommendations, summaries, data, photographs, notes and calculations (collectively "File Information") shall be and remain Engineer's property and are agreed by the Parties to be instruments of service. File Information shall be maintained in general accordance with Engineer's document retention policies and practices as may be amended from time to time by Engineer. Client may use any File Information prepared pursuant to the Agreement but Engineer reserves all other rights with respect to such File Information. Client shall obtain prior written consent from Engineer for any other use, distribution or publication of such File Information not contemplated by or under the Agreement. Unless otherwise expressly agreed to in writing, nothing contained herein shall be interpreted to prevent Engineer from using any File Information performed or prepared in accordance with the Agreement for current or future projects.
4. CLIENT RESPONSIBILITIES. Except as otherwise agreed, Client shall: (i) secure all necessary site related approvals, permits, licenses and consents necessary for Engineer to commence and complete the Services; (ii) permit Engineer reasonable access to the project as necessary for Engineer to perform the Services and Additional Services; (iii) execute any and all necessary site access agreements; (iv) ensure reasonable cooperation by and among parties involved in the project; and (v) provide whenever possible project data or detail including such as plans, drawings and specifications that will enable Engineer to perform its Services or Additional Services in accordance with the Agreement.
5. FEES, INVOICES AND PAYMENTS. The Client understands and agrees that the Proposal represents Engineer's reasonable estimate of the time and effort required to perform the Services. At the request of Client, Engineer shall provide a fee schedule (the "Fee Schedule") which shall be valid and binding upon the Engineer for the calendar year in which the Fee Schedule is issued and shall apply to any Additional Services not included in the Agreement. Engineer will invoice Client monthly and payment is due upon receipt of invoice. Client shall notify Engineer in writing, at an address provided, within fifteen (15) days of the date of the invoice if Client objects to any portion of the charges on the invoice. Client shall, however, promptly pay the undisputed portion. A service charge equal to one and one-half percent (1.5 %) per month will be applied, less the disputed portion, to all accounts which remain unpaid for more than thirty (30) calendar days beyond the date of the invoice. Client agrees to pay all collection-related costs, including reasonable attorneys' fees and court costs, which Engineer incurs in collecting or attempting to collect any amount owed by Client. Engineer may suspend Services of Additional Services for lack of timely payment and Client agrees to indemnify, defend and hold Engineer harmless from any and all claims, demands or causes of action resulting from same.
6. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY. The total aggregate liability of Engineer to Client or anyone claiming by, through or under Client is limited to the lesser of three (3) times the less the fees actually received by Engineer in performing the Services or Additional Services or the extent of available insurance, for any and all injuries, claims, losses, damages, loss, expenses, including attorneys' fees, expert fees or court costs and/or other damages arising out of, or in any way related to, Engineer's Services, Additional Services or to the Agreement from any cause or causes whatsoever, including but not limited to, negligent acts, errors or omissions, professional negligence, breach of contract, strict liability, indemnity or any other recovery.
7. WAIVER OF CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES. Client hereby waives all claims against Engineer for any consequential, incidental, or indirect damages, including loss of profit or business interruption, arising out of or related to Engineer's Services.
8. MUTUAL INDEMNITY. Engineer and Client shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless the other party and their agents, members, directors, officers, employees, shareholders and affiliates from and against liability for all claims, losses, damages, liabilities, costs, expenses and/or attorney's fees (collectively "Damages"), which may arise or result from the negligent acts or willful misconduct of the other party but only to the extent that such negligent act or willful misconduct causes Damages to the other party. In the event such Damages are caused by the joint or concurrent negligence of Engineer and Client, the Damages and resulting costs thereof shall be borne by each Party in proportion to its own negligence under comparative fault principles.
9. INSURANCE. Engineer shall maintain for the term of this Agreement insurance policies covering as may be reasonably necessary: (i) workers' compensation insurance and employer's liability insurance, statutory limits; (ii) commercial general liability Insurance, a total of $1,000,000.00 each occurrence and $2,000,000.00 in aggregate; (iii) automobile liability insurance a total of $1,000,000.00; and (iv) professional liability insurance a total of $1,000,000.00 each occurrence and $1,000,000.00 in aggregate. Certificates of insurance will be provided upon request. Client and Engineer shall waive subrogation against the other party on all general liability and property damage coverage.
10. DISPUTE RESOLUTION. Client shall not assert a claim, demand or cause of action of any kind against Engineer based on any theory of professional negligence unless and until Client has obtained the written opinion from a registered, independent, and reputable structural engineer or licensed architect unequivocally stating that Engineer has violated the standard of care applicable to Engineer's performance of the Services. Client shall provide this opinion to Engineer and the Parties shall endeavor to resolve the dispute within thirty (30) days, after which Client may pursue its remedies at law. As a condition precedent to the initiation of any legal proceedings, the Parties shall engage in non-binding mediation using a mutually agreed mediator. Costs of mediation shall be shared equally.
11. GOVERNING LAW AND CHOICE OF VENUE. All matters of conflict arising directly or indirectly from this Agreement and Engineer's performance of Services and Additional Services shall be governed by and construed according to the laws of the State of Wisconsin law. The Circuit Court of Sheboygan County, State of Wisconsin shall be the sole and exclusive venue for all matters and causes of action arising by and between the Parties and relating directly or indirectly to this Agreement or Engineer's performance of Services or Additional Services. The Parties voluntarily waive any claim or defense of forum non conveniens (inconvenient forum) as it relates to appearance in the Circuit Court located in Sheboygan County, Wisconsin.
12. CONFIDENTIALITY. To the extent that Client discloses to Engineer information that is identified by Client as being confidential or sensitive, Engineer will exercise its reasonable efforts to prevent the disclosure of such information to others. Nothing herein is meant to prevent, nor shall be interpreted as preventing, Engineer from disclosing and/or using or making public in any way the File Information: (i) when the File Information is actually known to the receiving party before being obtained from Engineer; (ii) when the File Information is generally available to the public regardless of Engineer disclosure; (iii) where the File Information is obtained or acquired in good faith at any time by the receiving party from a third party; (iv) where a written release is obtained by the receiving party from the Client; (v) six (6) years following Engineer's receipt of the confidential information; or (vi) when disclosure is required by process of law provided that Engineer, upon service of such process or receipt of legal notice, uses its reasonable efforts to notify the Client and afford Client an opportunity to resist such process.
13. ASSIGNMENT. This Agreement shall not be assigned by the Parties without the prior written consent of the other, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld.
14. TERMINATION. Either Party may terminate the Agreement with or without cause upon ten (10) days' prior written notice to the other Party. In such case, Engineer shall be paid costs incurred and fees earned through and including the date of termination.
15. ENTIRE AGREEMENT. Unless amended or modified pursuant to the terms contained herein, the Agreement constitutes the entire agreement by and between Engineer and Client relating to the provision of the Services by Engineer to Client.
16. WAIVER. No failure of Engineer or Client to enforce any term or provision of this Agreement or to exercise any right or privilege in the Agreement or the waiver by Engineer or Client of any breach of the terms or conditions of this Agreement shall be deemed to be a waiver by the same party of any other breach of any kind or nature, and the same shall continue and remain in force and effect as if no such failure to enforce had occurred.
17. SEVERABILITY AND SURVIVAL. Each provision of this Agreement is severable from the others. Should any provision of this Agreement be found invalid or unenforceable, such provision shall be ineffective only to the extent required by law, without invalidating the remainder of such provision or the remainder of this Agreement. Further, to the extent permitted by law, any provision found invalid or unenforceable shall be deemed automatically redrawn to the extent necessary to render it valid and enforceable consistent with the Parties' intent. The terms and conditions set forth herein shall survive the termination of this Agreement.
18. NOTICE OF LIEN RIGHTS. AS REQUIRED BY STATE LAW GOVERNING CONSTRUCTION LIENS, CLIENT IS HEREBY NOTIFIED THAT PERSONS OR COMPANIES FURNISHING LABOR OR MATERIALS FOR CONSTRUCTION ON CLIENT'S LAND MAY HAVE LIEN RIGHTS IF NOT PAID. THOSE ENTITLED TO LIEN RIGHTS, IN ADDITION TO ENGINEER, ARE THOSE WHO CONTRACT DIRECTLY WITH CLIENT OR THOSE WHO GIVE CLIENT NOTICE WITHIN SIXTY (60) DAYS AFTER THEY FIRST FURNISH SERVICES. CLIENT MAY NEED TO NOTIFY ITS MORTGAGE LENDER(S) OF THESE LIEN RIGHTS.
